label: TRELLIS.2
description: TRELLIS.2 image-to-3D: one upstream image (background auto-removed via BiRefNet) to a vertex-colored mesh GLB. Graph from ComfyUI's official 3d_pixal3d_trellis2_image_to_model template with the TRELLIS.2 switch on; remesh 768 + decimate to 200k faces + vertex paint. Requires trellis_2_int8_convrot + both TRELLIS.2 VAEs + dino_v3_L_naf + birefnet — see workflows/model/README.md. Optional custom param: seed.
